Brussels Housing: comparison of minimum requirements

Student housing surface: 12 m² for one person, 18 m² for two. Habitable rooms at least 70% of dwelling area. Collective common rooms allocated by maximum residents using them. These are housing-code minima; planning/fire rules can be stricter.

Student housing minimum surface

2026 housing-code rules: student dwelling minimum 12 m² for one person, 18 m² for two. Habitable rooms must cover at least 70% of dwelling area. Collective common rooms counted pro rata by maximum residents using them.
Do not equate 12 m² with a universal private-bedroom minimum. Architect must calculate qualifying area and apply stricter planning/fire rules; 28 m² gross allocation is not compliance proof.
